outcome: S1: implement the bounded host review identity engine, CLI, API and MCP operation

Named refusals cover unsupported or incomplete input; Engram schema-1 behavior stays unchanged; no caller-controlled shell, script, Git command or write capability is added.

Focused automated tests pass on the judged source revision and cover the input classes, independent canonical golden vectors, nested and uninitialized repository semantics, Windows/Unix profile and link rules, refusal and resource limits, concurrent-change detection, actual compiled CLI behavior, HTTP observation/authority and Claude/Codex MCP capability boundaries. These tests establish the S1 implementation contract, without claiming an activated live reviewer witness.

The maintained full five-stage gate passes on the exact S1 input to be landed, and an independent Codex plus Claude read-only review pair has no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding. This changeset contains engine/CLI/API/MCP implementation and tests; shared review-procedure/authority changes and the post-activation live Claude/Codex witness remain outside this S1 item and owed by the parent.
